generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch on E-GMP (800 V). 58 kWh Standard Range (DC ~180 kW) and 77.4 kWh Long Range (DC ~240 kW); CCS1 port on the right rear. The EV6 GT was dropped in Canada after MY2024. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_EV6

generations.name: 2025 refresh
generations.notes: 84 kWh pack replaces 77.4 kWh (and ~63 kWh replaces 58 kWh on the Standard Range); Georgia-built cars get a native NACS port, moved to the driver's side. Canada: last_year 2025 (EV5 takes its place; reported by press, no formal Kia Canada notice). US continues past 2025, so no last_year is set. The 63 kWh Standard Range figure for the refresh was not on a fetched page; check it. The Korea-built GT may keep CCS. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kia_EV6 ; https://newswire.ca/news-releases/the-refreshed-2025-kia-ev6-is-now-available-in-canada-featuring-more-range-advanced-technology-and-enhanced-battery-capacity-816940511.html ; https://driveteslacanada.ca/news/kia-ev6-will-not-return-to-canada-for-2026/
